title: Geometric fibres detect exactness in the constructible adic heart
statement: Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum of [rem-dl-a1-conventions]. Let $Y_0$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism], put $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], and use the constructible heart $\Sh_c(Y,\Qlb)$ [def-weil-constructible-heart] of the rationalized/common-finite-coefficient-stage adic category [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category]. For a geometric point $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}k\to Y$, let $\mathcal G_{\bar y}$ denote the geometric coefficient fibre, computed by derived pullback to $\operatorname{Spec}k$ and the point-fibre functor [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point, def-weil-coefficient-cohomology-modules]. These fibre functors are exact and jointly conservative on the constructible heart. Thus a morphism in this heart is zero if all its geometric fibres are zero, and a short complex [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] is short exact if and only if the corresponding sequence of finite-dimensional $\Qlb$-vector spaces is short exact at every geometric point. The same assertions hold for constructible Weil sheaves [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex] after forgetting the Weil structure. Exactness of locally constructible adic sheaf sequences on a locally finite-type $k_0$-scheme can be checked on a covering by separated finite-type open subschemes. This assertion concerns constructible adic coefficient fibres, not arbitrary sheaves on the pro-etale topos.

Applied to the constructible heart, with rationalization and common-stage coefficients as specified in the statement.

proof.text: A map $s=\operatorname{Spec}k\to Y$ is a closed $k$-point composed with an automorphism of $s$ (a self-embedding of $\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ permutes every finite subfield) [lem-weil-pbc-section-separated-closed-immersion]; the schemes are Noetherian [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian]. For a locally closed immersion $a$, [lem-sf-immersion-completed-pullback-comparison] and [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization] give an exact integral inverse image, extended to $D^b_c(-,E)$ by [prop-weil-pbc-rational-transport]. It preserves each standard half: represent an object of that half by an integral object of the corresponding integral half [def-weil-constructible-standard-tstructure] and apply the integral inverse image; at $\Qlb$ it acts stagewise. By [lem-a1-point-realization-standard-cohomology], $\operatorname{Fib}_{s,E}$ and $\operatorname{Fib}_{s,\Qlb}$ are exact and $t$-exact with finite-dimensional values, so each composite is $t$-exact and exact on hearts [lem-weil-heart-short-exact-triangles](4).

proof.text: A heart object $(E,K)$ is isomorphic to $(E,F_E)$ with $F_E=\tau^{\ge0}\tau^{\le0}K\in\Sh_c(Y,E)$, truncations being computed at a finite stage [prop-constructible-truncations, prop-weil-pbc-common-stage-calculus]; its fibre at $\bar y$ is $(E,\operatorname{Fib}_{s,E}(L\bar y^*F_E))$ [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]. If it vanishes, so does $\operatorname{Fib}_{s,E}(L\bar y^*F_E)$, as $V\otimes_E M=0$ forces $V=0$. [lem-dl-a1-heart-connected-lisse-strata] supplies connected lisse strata, and [lem-dl-a1-finite-stage-fibre-vanishing] computes their ranks and gives $F_E=0$ by open–closed devissage.

proof.text: By [lem-sp-exact-functor-preserves-homology], exact fibres preserve kernels, cokernels and images. Fibrewise invertibility of $u$ makes its kernel and cokernel zero by Step 2, so $u$ is invertible; fibrewise zero makes its image zero, so $u=0$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-jointly-reflect-short-exact] to these exact, jointly conservative functors to obtain the short-exactness criterion.

source.place: §6.8, Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15; assembly of returned proof.

proof.text: Frobenius pullback is an autoequivalence commuting with standard truncations [prop-constructible-truncations]. In the fixed-pair description [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex, def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category], the kernel universal property applied to the equivariance square induces its Frobenius isomorphism; the inverse comes from the inverse structure maps. The cokernel has the dual construction. Thus forgetting creates kernels and cokernels and is faithful, exact and reflects exactness. Applying Steps 1–3 after forgetting proves the Weil assertions.

source.place: §6.8, Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15; assembly of returned proof.

proof.text: By [lem-dl-a1-local-heart-cover-defects], the left kernel, middle homology and right cokernel are computed on separated finite-type opens, and vanish exactly when their restrictions to the covering vanish. A short complex is short exact exactly when these three defects vanish; this gives the locality assertion, including non-quasi-compact schemes.
